children: Micron and Samsung compete to supply HBM4 for NVIDIA (NVDA) Rubin. Micron ships 12-layer HBM4 volume and 48GB 16-layer samples; Samsung mass-produced HBM4 in February and awaits 16-layer demand.
Estimates show major cloud/tech buyers—Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, Oracle—may spend ~$795B in 2026 and ~$1.08T in 2027, supporting demand for NVIDIA (NVDA) data-center products.
NVIDIA (NVDA) may invest up to $10 billion in Anthropic’s potential IPO, with potential tied deals for future GPU and computing-system purchases linked to Anthropic’s growth.
NVDA outsources advanced chip production to foundries like TSMC, making supply, capacity and regional risks key factors for traders monitoring production and delivery timelines.
Analysts show Buy consensus for NVIDIA (NVDA) with average target ~$348. Key notes: Piper Sandler starts Overweight $300, Rosenblatt Buy $390, Needham Buy $300.
Analyst Ives says US AI-driven data center expansion will boost demand for NVIDIA (NVDA) hardware, highlighting NVDA's key role in server GPU deployments and infrastructure build-out.
NVIDIA's Nemotron models are supported in Cisco's new AI POD for Splunk, letting traders run Splunk AI locally on private or air‑gapped systems for on‑prem data processing.
Fund manager says NVIDIA (NVDA) not expensive long-term but warns data-center buildout risks could pressure NVDA and other chipmakers if demand for data-center hardware slows.
NVDA shares climbed ~1.1% after CEO Jensen Huang, speaking at the All‑In Summit in Los Angeles alongside former President Trump, pushed back on AI doomsday warnings.
